name: apiflow
description: APIFlow — Visual API Workflow Automation and Testing Platform

scripts.dev: start "APIFlow Backend" cmd /k "cd backend && npm run dev" && start "APIFlow Frontend" cmd /k "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
